headline: Hot flash PMI lifts front-end yields; NQ holds session lows in one-way post-event structure
body: The S&P Global flash US composite PMI printed 58.4 against a 55.2 consensus at 13:45Z, a five-year high, with manufacturing at 57.0 and services at 58.7 and input costs rising at the fastest pace since October 2022. The reaction has been a hawkish rate repricing rather than a growth celebration: the 2-year yield is up about 12bp to 4.87% and the 10-year is at 5.04%, both near session highs, while long-duration equities de-rate. NDX trades 30,388.70, down 1.12%, and NQ futures at 30,685.00 sit roughly four points above the 30,680.75 session low after sweeping down from a 31,094.75 high, having never traded above the prior close. Semiconductors and most megacaps are on the weak side, and WTI at 91.85 is up about 1.5%, rebounding from a two-week low as US-Iran talks at the UN continue alongside unresolved Strait of Hormuz and blockade questions. The counterweight is volatility: VIX at 14.71 is up only 3.5% and remains low in absolute terms, which is consistent with orderly repricing rather than a disorderly liquidation. Tail is therefore set at the threshold rather than above it, reflecting observed persistent one-way structure and aligned cross-asset amplifiers, balanced against a contained volatility regime and a move of ordinary daily magnitude. Stress is elevated on the size of the front-end move, the oil rebound and live geopolitical exposure. Confidence is high: current index, futures, volatility, yield and oil levels were read directly, and the PMI outcome was verified against published reporting. The shared Finviz context was stale and partial for this run and was used only for discovery.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours were dominated by a quiet, mean-reverting overnight regime. Tail held between 10 and 15 from the 02:00Z hour through 11:00Z with dominant mode normal, after a modest trend-up phase during the prior US session that peaked at Tail 21 around 14:00Z and 19:00Z on 22 September. Conditions began firming from 12:00Z today as mode shifted to mixed and Stress rose from 35 to 40 into the 13:00Z hour, immediately ahead of the flash PMI release.
outlookSummary: The near-term path is governed by how the post-PMI rate repricing resolves. Tail is held at the block threshold through the active repricing phase and the 17:00Z five-year note auction, then steps down through the US close on the assumption that two-way trade returns and volatility decays. Overnight conditional Tail falls into the low teens with dominant mode normal, before rising again into Thursday's 12:30Z jobless claims and the 13:30Z cash open, where a second rate-driven impulse would become visible if it develops. None of the post-current-hour structure is observed; it is stated conditionally.
